<action type="say">
Yes, I can help you get several quotes.

To request quotes from multiple plumbers, I need a few details:
1) Full service address in Portland (street, unit/apt if any, ZIP).
2) Timing:
   - How urgent is this? (emergency / same_day / routine)
   - Any preferred date(s) and time window (morning/afternoon/evening)?
3) A bit more detail about the job:
   - Is this just swapping an old faucet for a new one, or is new plumbing/holes needed?
   - Do you already have the new faucet? If so, what type (single-handle, pull-down sprayer, touch/voice-activated, etc.)?
   - Is the sink already installed and accessible (no cabinetry issues, disposal in place, etc.)?

Once you share that, I’ll pull a few quotes and show you the options.</action>
